SPECIFICATION FOR 

HEEL SOCKET AND PLATE FOR ORTHOSIS 


{ First Revision ) 


1. Scope — This standard covers dimensional and other requirements for heel socket and plate of 
two types for orthopaedic calipers and braces. 


2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 and 2, for types 1 and 2. 

3. Material — Hot-rolled mild steel sheet, conforming to IS: 1079-1973 ‘Specification for hot 
rolled carbon steel sheet and strip ( third revision)' or cold-rolled carbon steel sheets [see 
IS : 513 -1973 ‘Specification for cold rolled carbon steel sheets ( second revision )]•’ 


4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The heel socket and plate shall be well finished, free from toolmarks, rough edges and other 
surface defects. 


4.2 The socket shall be soundly welded or brazed to the plate. 

4.3 The assembly shall be zinc plated in accordance with IS: 1573-1970 ‘Specification for 
elctroplated coatings of zinc on iron and steel (first revision)'. 

5. Marking — The heel socket and plate shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; 

b) Size; and 

c) Marking of 'Right or Left' on the heel socket. 

5.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standard Institution. 


6. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

7. Sampling — A sampling scheme and criteria for acceptance shall be as agreed to between the 
purchaser and the manufacturer; however a recommended scheme is given below. 


7.1 Lot — All those sets of heel sockets and plates of the same type shall be grouped together 
to constitute a lot. "Each lot shall be tested for the requirements of this specification. 


7.2 Each set of heel sockets and plates for orthosis" 
(2) and workmanship and finish (4). All 
requirements shall be rejected and only 
accepted.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 


This standard was first published in 1970. The standard is being revised mainly to incorporate 
certain changes in shape and dimensions.
